title: UNDERCROFT FLOOR TEXT
why: The hub floor has equal-weight station names, a tiny amber title and a tiny control line. The style guide calls for clear hierarchy and readable hints.
now: A cream title, quiet station names, one lime raid hero and readable control key chips.
